workflow: An owned isolated AutoCAD 24.3 process creates three Model entities, plots Extents on A4 portrait at fixed 1:50 centered, Window on A3 landscape Fit with a 4/6 mm offset, and the live Display on A4 portrait at fixed 1:100 centered through DWG To PDF.pc3, then saves and reopens the synthetic DWG.
result: All native page-setup modes and three PlotToFile calls passed. The reopened DWG preserved the final Display setup; pypdf/pdfplumber found one vector-only page and zero image XObjects in every PDF, Poppler rendered painted geometry, and the owned process terminated with the pre-existing process set restored.
